author: Times Radio
description:
“We’re seeing a display of the levels of corruption that now have taken hold in the United States.”

Trump’s role in the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO shows “corruption” within the US, considering Trump’s “huge” financial interests and relationship with the company, says barrister and Labour peer Helena Kennedy.

Helena Kennedy and William Hague were speaking to Kate McCann and Stig Abell on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every Monday to Thursday, 6-10am.

author: Times Radio
description:
“I have to ask all those moral and social conservatives who have either been prepared to support Mr. Trump or have made excuses for him over the years, who it was they thought they were supporting?”

Peter Hitchens asks a frank question of Donald Trump’s supporters, citing his intervention over Nvidia as one of the clearest examples “that he isn’t one of them”.

Lionel Shriver and Peter Hitchens were speaking to Kait Borsay on The Evening Edition on Times Radio. Listen live every Monday to Thursday, 7-10pm.

description:
“Ukraine, I think, is showing its mettle.”

Ukraine’s successful strike on Russian targets further afield showing there is “no platform or asset anywhere in the world that is beyond reach”, says former head of the Royal Navy’s Strategic Studies Centre Kevin Rowlands.

description:

description:
“It’s a national embarrassment and it’s a national security disaster. There may also be serious economic consequences.”

Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO poses a great risk to American, British, and European companies of being targeted by Chinese or Russian intelligence says fomer US diplomat Brett Bruen.

Brett Bruen was speaking to Carole Walker on Times Radio. Listen live on Times Radio every Monday to Wednesday, from 10pm-1am.
